stepTitle: The first peak of $$\sin(Ax)$$ occurs at $$x=\frac{\pi}{2}$$. The first peak of $$\sin(Bx)$$ occurs at $$x=1$$. Which graph represents a function with a higher frequency?

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Two sine curves: sin of Ax has maximum value at pi over 2 and minimum at negative pi over 2; sin of Bx has maximum value at 1 and minimum value at negative 1.
